winning_diff:
--- a/nautilus_v5/commons/context/compactor.py
+++ b/nautilus_v5/commons/context/compactor.py
@@ -196,6 +196,21 @@
     out = list(messages[:head_end])
     if summary:
-        out.append({"role": "user", "content": f"{_SUMMARY_PREFIX}\n{summary}"})
-    out.extend(messages[tail_start:])
+        summary_text = f"{_SUMMARY_PREFIX}\n{summary}"
+        tail_first = messages[tail_start] if tail_start < n else None
+        if tail_first is not None and tail_first.get("role") == "user":
+            # Fold the summary into the first kept tail turn so the injected
+            # user message never sits adjacent to another user message.
+            merged = dict(tail_first)
+            merged["content"] = summary_text + "\n\n" + (merged.get("content") or "")
+            out.append(merged)
+            out.extend(messages[tail_start + 1:])
+        elif out and out[-1].get("role") == "user":
+            # Protected head already ends with a user turn; fold into it instead.
+            merged = dict(out[-1])
+            merged["content"] = (merged.get("content") or "") + "\n\n" + summary_text
+            out[-1] = merged
+            out.extend(messages[tail_start:])
+        else:
+            out.append({"role": "user", "content": summary_text})
+            out.extend(messages[tail_start:])
+    else:
+        out.extend(messages[tail_start:])
     out = _sanitize_tool_pairs(out)
     return out, (summary or None)
